title: Mark alerts as resolved
summary: Complete one or several alerts that have already been worked on.

steps.title: Menu → Alerts Center
steps.details: What the system detected with the alert rules and the team needs to work on.

steps.title: Check the alerts
steps.details: Check each resolved alert, or the category's checkbox to check them all. The action bar shows up at the bottom.

steps.title: Mark as completed
steps.details: They become Completed and leave the pending list.
